neighbours.label: In sports reports, the stage a player or team reaches in a named tournament or cup (last 16, round of 32, first round, knockout stage, semi-final stage of the X Cup), and win-loss records phrased 'on the season' (12-3 on the season); also the board name 'Arduino' in electronics text. Quiet for 'last' or 'round' outside competitions (last stop, funding round, round of cuts), records phrased 'this year' or 'for the year', and plain match action with no stage or record.
neighbours.short: tournament stage reached / 'on the season' record (+ Arduino)
